metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Vipul Chauhan.

plugins.name: product-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for building new products. Includes a design system builder that turns a brief, screenshots, or a brand palette into design tokens, light and dark themes, component specs, and a WCAG contrast report, a project planner that splits a spec into phases for a coding agent, and a doc trimmer that cuts hedging, filler, and repeated ideas from text, files, or URLs.
